findings.description: SWR-SAF-009 evaluates the retained elapsed time at fault detection, while SWR-SAF-011 also updates that time at the same detection. Neither requirement specifies which happens first. If the retained value is below 60 s but the update brings it to 60 s or more, the order changes whether this detection continues the sequence or starts a new one under SWR-SAF-012.
findings.requested_change: Specify that the elapsed-time update for the detection is applied before evaluating the sequence condition, and make the ordering consistent across SWR-SAF-009 and SWR-SAF-012.

findings.description: The requirement prescribes additions at each control-cycle end, at fault detection and before reset, as well as how each increment is calculated. SYS-SUP-028 and CON-SUP-136 specify the allowable accumulated-time error, but do not require this particular accounting algorithm or update schedule.
findings.requested_change: State the required elapsed-time behavior and error bounds without prescribing the update algorithm and schedule, or record an explicit source and justification for making those choices software requirements.
